The star factor H1 is the leaf augmentation lattice; integral join Kunneth and degree-one join sign (+1) give the tensor module. Tensor-cycle trace yields the character. Wedge homotopy is verified via joins and independently via the general staged acyclic leaf-toggle matching. The accompanying verifier exhaustively confirms nine small branches, complete Hasse acyclicity and exact F2 boundary ranks, and sign-correct Lefschetz traces. Edge case b_i=1 yields contractibility.
